correctness.rationale: The weighted Frobenius objective expands to a strictly convex quadratic with Hessian A Hadamard A; SPD of this Hessian follows from the Schur product theorem. Normalizing yields the exact three-dimensional Cramer formulas, all coefficient sign boundaries including equality, a proof that two nonpositive coefficients cannot coexist, and strict positivity in smaller dimensions. A two-mode SPD check and direct inversion give a nonempty exact sign-loss window for the star family. Exact KKT conditions yield the unique nonnegative-cone minimizer and its positive rational gap; the open SPD cone has the same unattained infimum. The rational example has positive leading principal minors and one negative fitted diagonal, and a standalone standard-library exact-rational verifier passed 3614 grouped checks. Finite checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: Diagonal (Band1) support is a naturally motivated sparse approximate inverse pattern. The sharp classification converts an existing qualitative positivity warning into an exact necessary-and-sufficient test for every 3-by-3 SPD input; the minimal dimension and nonempty phase window explain when the simplest case fails. The exact convex-cone objective penalty quantifies the price of repairing the fit in the same metric, a precise datum useful in preconditioner design. No general PDE result or practical iteration guarantee is asserted.
